name: 滚动全幅展开
title: 滚动全幅展开
description: 一个圆角媒体框随滚动长成通栏：滚动条隐藏的内部滚动器（或绑定页面滚动）喂出一个进度值，全部画面由帧上的一条 clip-path inset 与媒体的一档 scale 推演——框从居中圆角长到全幅，媒体从 1.35 倍松弛回 1，压暗蒙层同步升起，大标题在中段上浮退场、底部提示在开头消散、覆盖层内容在全幅时浮现；sticky 舞台 + 可调展开段与保持段，指数跟随让进度有迟滞，减少动态直接贴合，resize 重测不残留旧姿态。
cardDescription: 圆角媒体框随滚动展开成通栏，覆盖层在全幅时浮现。
keywords: 圆角媒体框随滚动展开成通栏

prompt:
Implement the "ScrollExpand" component from zero: a rounded media frame — image or looping muted video — that grows to full bleed as the user scrolls through a tall stage, then holds there while optional overlay content fades in. It drives everything from one progress value through a single clip-path inset on the frame and one scale on the media, with a big centre title that lifts away and a scroll hint that dissolves at the start. Works as its own hidden-scrollbar scroller or bound to the window scroll; progress can be smoothed with an exponential follower, and reduced motion snaps instantly. Full specification follows; it must not depend on external pages, font files, or off-the-shelf effect components. ## Structure & rendering - Pure React + CSS, two files only: ScrollExpand.jsx (entry, scroll engine) and ScrollExpand.css (all styles). React >= 18; no runtime dependencies. No iframe. - Root is a `
` with class scroll-expand plus scroll-expand--scroller unless useWindowScroll is set, plus any className: position relative, width 100%, height 100%. The scroller variant adds overflow-y auto, overflow-x hidden, hidden scrollbars (scrollbar-width none, -ms-overflow-style none, ::-webkit-scrollbar display none) and overscroll-behavior contain — all scrolling happens inside it. - Inside is a track `
` (relative, full width) whose height the engine sets to stageHeight × (1 + max(0, scrollDistance) + max(0, holdDistance)) — the extra distances are the expand span and the fully-expanded hold span, both measured in stage heights. Inside the track, a stage `
`: position sticky, top 0, width 100%, overflow hidden, and a --se-title-size custom property (fallback 4rem) the engine keeps at clamp(width × 0.075, 20, 84) px. - Inside the stage: the frame `
` (absolute inset 0, will-change clip-path, initial clip-path inset(21% 29% 21% 29% round 24px) matching the default start geometry) holding the media, a scrim, and the overlay; then the title and the hint as sticky-stage-level siblings. - Media: mediaType "image" renders `` with src, alt, draggable false; mediaType "video" renders `
